title: Segfault trying to import torch

labels.name: module: crash
labels.description: Problem manifests as a hard crash, as opposed to a RuntimeError

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

labels.name: module: regression
labels.description: It used to work, and now it doesn't

labels.name: module: debug-build
labels.description: Related to building and testing PyTorch in debug mode

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

`python -c 'import torch'` segfaults when reaching [this line](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/50c0550f5a5b1e35885d892081a7d5115d8b4489/torch/__init__.py#L426).  I bisected the problem to this change: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/163527 (cc: @swolchok)
